title: Knowledge Wiki foundation and governed projection
objective: Establish a useful Markdown-first semantic wiki over the existing canonical evidence system without duplicating authority, weakening protection, or confusing archival depth with public selection.

selection_order: privacy, rights, consent, or locator leak
duplicate authority or stale generated artifact
broken identity, relation, link, fragment, or correction

hard_constraints: M is primary; N and D may add only compatible detail.
The existing typed records own exact claims, sources, evidence, rights, corrections, and citation plans.
Markdown owns page identity, context, authored links, and human orientation.
Generated graphs, reports, backlinks, and indexes are derived and never canonical.
Raw private archives, local locators, authenticated state, credentials, and unapproved media remain outside Git.
Access authorization permits research but does not automatically permit quotation, retention, publication, or promotion.
A materially researched page records the present question, original-source class, actual scope, changed and unchanged understanding, access boundary, and next return.
Unavailable, unmaterialized, deliberately unprocessed, and not-recovered sources remain explicit states rather than invitations to substitute prior summaries.
A wiki node is not portfolio selection or publication approval.
Not-recovered is never converted into never-existed.
The optimizing agent cannot grade its own patch or manufacture independent or human approval.
No public proofs, knowledge-bank, knowledge-wiki, or public-claims route may exist.

evals.title: One authority model without a second truth tree
procedure: Inventory authored, canonical, derived, projected, and private layers.
Check that the compatibility root is singular and authority is assigned once.
pass_criteria: No docs/knowledge-wiki content fork exists.
Typed records remain authoritative for exact evidence objects.
Generated artifacts declare themselves derived.
evals.remediation_hint: Remove the duplicate record and bind the surviving representation to its canonical owner.
cannot_establish: that every historical dossier has completed semantic migration

evals.title: Stable identity, links, graph, and reachability
procedure: Validate IDs, aliases, fields, dates, links, fragments, relations, and canonical references.
Compile twice and compare fingerprints.
Check typed orphans and root reachability.
pass_criteria: No duplicate or unresolved identity exists.
No broken link, fragment, or edge exists.
The pilot is reachable and deterministic.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the smallest authored or canonical relationship and regenerate.
cannot_establish: the long-term desirability of every relation type

evals.title: Evidence governance and protected-source thresholds
procedure: Inspect the derived protected node and serialized reports.
Search for private locators and run mutation tests.
pass_criteria: Protected source titles and locators do not enter the graph.
Rights, consent, and display holds remain visible.
Private paths fail closed.
evals.remediation_hint: Reduce the derived node to approved metadata and restore the strictest applicable hold.
cannot_establish: rights clearance, participant consent, or permission to publish

evals.title: Corrections, anti-claims, wanted pages, and negative knowledge
procedure: Traverse chronology, superlative, and time corrections.
Verify the unrecovered event page remains a wanted page with bounded language.
Mutate absence language toward never-existed and require failure.
pass_criteria: Superseded wording remains auditable.
The dedicated event page remains not-recovered rather than disproven.
Wanted pages do not become dangling assertions.
evals.remediation_hint: Restore the bounded search result and the canonical correction link.
cannot_establish: that an unrecovered record never existed

evals.title: Job-search query usefulness
procedure: Ask what demonstrates Technical Operations.
Trace the CouncilStat time claim to its source.
Inspect the protected photo and active correction.
pass_criteria: A cold user can retrieve a capability, project, method, opportunity, source path, correction, and boundary by stable ID.
Unknown options and zero matches fail distinctly.
evals.remediation_hint: Add the smallest relation or query affordance that answers the failed work question.
cannot_establish: that the retrieved material should appear on the homepage

evals.title: VS Code reader and author experience
procedure: Open the repository cold and follow Start Here.
Check link validation, file-move behavior, authoring steps, and human-task output.
pass_criteria: The root gives useful entry points.
Authoring routes exact records to their existing owner.
Human tasks name owners and artifacts without fabricated results.
evals.remediation_hint: Remove setup friction or clarify the next human action without adding a second interface.
cannot_establish: measured reader success without an actual consented study

evals.title: Selective portfolio projection and prohibited-route guard
procedure: Run projection and route checks.
Verify current work.ts projection authority remains unchanged.
Search for prohibited public wiki routes.
pass_criteria: The wiki does not automatically publish nodes.
Existing public surfaces retain fail-closed bindings.
No proofs or wiki route exists.
evals.remediation_hint: Remove the accidental projection or bind it to an approved selected claim.
cannot_establish: human approval of the current public composition

evals.title: Chad lens: hiring clarity and strategic depth
procedure: Give a blind judge the exact candidate and frozen criterion.
Ask what Jamie can own, what proof earns confidence, and what remains bounded.
pass_criteria: The job-relevant offer is legible without flattening the deeper practice.
Actor, action, usable result, and boundary are concrete.
The wiki improves future application composition rather than becoming an archive tour.
evals.remediation_hint: Make the strongest defensible professional action easier to retrieve and connect to present value.
cannot_establish: fit for every employer or permission to publish held material

evals.title: Jamie voice: tender civic architecture with editorial restraint
procedure: Assess whether care becomes structure, uncertainty remains material, and the future reader is respected.
Check that lyrical language does not obscure operational meaning.
pass_criteria: The prose is warm, precise, relational, and usable.
Uncertainty carries no shame and no inflated certainty.
Operational readers can still act quickly.
evals.remediation_hint: Replace abstraction with one precise human consequence or operating action.
cannot_establish: literal authorship by Jamie for AI-assisted text

evals.title: Warren Sack lens: recursive systems become inspectable
procedure: Inspect whether relations become analysis, working form, and reusable inquiry.
Trace an event-project-capability-method sequence and a claim-source-correction sequence.
pass_criteria: At least two recursive sequences are demonstrable rather than merely described.
Stable relations support further discovery without erasing context.
evals.remediation_hint: Add or repair one relation that turns a stated pattern into a traversable working form.

evals.title: Margaret Morse lens: embodied and relational knowledge remains present
procedure: Assess whether the wiki preserves events, participation, media, and lived thresholds alongside operational artifacts.
Check that protection does not collapse embodied evidence into absence.
pass_criteria: The artistic, civic, technical, and social dimensions remain connected.
Protected media remains meaningful as governed metadata.
The portfolio utility does not erase relational practice.
evals.remediation_hint: Restore one concrete place, event, relation, or protected threshold without inventing access.
cannot_establish: literal endorsement by Margaret Morse or consent to display protected media

evals.title: Human authority and release decision remain honest
procedure: Require Jamie to review the exact candidate separately from machine and LLM evidence.
Keep collaborator credit, media rights, and release decisions with their named owners.
pass_criteria: The optimizer does not claim Jamie's approval.
Open rights or collaborator decisions stay open.
Release occurs only after an exact-candidate human decision.
evidence_required: named rights and credit decisions where applicable
evals.remediation_hint: Report the candidate as implementation-ready but human-held until the named decision exists.
cannot_establish: human approval, rights clearance, collaborator consent, or production release without the named action

evals.title: Missing project overviews become bounded, traversable pages
procedure: Verify all five pages are authored semantic nodes reachable from the root and project directory.
Check each page uses canonical claim IDs rather than restating an independent evidence registry.
Trace every overview to a capability, method, source, or adjacent project.
pass_criteria: All five pages compile with valid links, relations, and canonical references.
Each project overview distinguishes Jamie's action, collective work, outcome, and boundary.
No new public route or automatic projection is created.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the smallest missing overview, canonical reference, relation, or action-outcome boundary.
cannot_establish: that every historical project now has a complete overview
that any new Wiki page should be projected to the portfolio

evals.title: Original-source access and present-tense rereading remain operational
procedure: Check every new priority page records the present question, original material, actual scope, changed and unchanged understanding, access boundary, and next return.
Verify protected sources use opaque IDs or classes and expose no private locator or authenticated state.
Mutate a source return by removing its boundary or adding a private locator and require failure.
Verify unavailable sources route to a bounded personal-librarian request rather than a fabricated result.
pass_criteria: Priority source-return sections are complete and dated to the exact candidate.
The method distinguishes access from publication permission and includes not-materialized, not-recovered, and deliberately-unprocessed states.
The librarian protocol names the smallest unblocker and cannot fabricate source access.
evals.remediation_hint: Return to the original source or record the honest access state, bounded librarian request, and next question without exposing the locator.
cannot_establish: that every accessible source should be processed
